note: Only public, no-auth job endpoints. Nothing here needs a credential, which is what lets the daily run stay unattended. Indeed's Partner API is deliberately NOT used: _os/automation/lib/indeed-api.js holds employer-side hiring signals for prospecting and needs INDEED_* secrets that are not configured.
slug_note: Every slug below returned HTTP 200 when probed on 2026-09-09. Companies move between Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby without notice, so a slug going 404 is expected drift, not a bug — the run logs it and carries on. When the source table in the daily report shows a board failing for a week, re-probe it and move it to the right platform here. Remote-only aggregators (himalayas, jobicy) were added on 2026-09-09 when remote became a hard requirement — a general board wastes most of its rows on on-site reqs.

aggregators.note: Remote-first board. Its server-side category filter is unreliable, so the fetch is broad and filtering happens locally.
Mixed EU/US board. Most rows are non-US and get dropped by the location gate; kept for the US remote marketing rows the other sources miss.
Remote-only board, ~104k live rows, paginated 20 at a time. Its locationRestrictions field is authoritative: an empty list means genuinely open, so it maps cleanly onto the remote gate.
Remote-only board with an industry filter and a jobGeo field that usually names the country outright. Queried unfiltered plus marketing and business.

board_note: AI-forward product companies plus marketing-tech firms where an agency operator's paid/SEO/attribution background transfers. Boards that 404 are skipped silently — one dead company slug must never cost the day's list.
